beats.subline: Thursday, July 30, 2026 close — a sharp rebound led by Microsoft's blowout earnings.
beats.body: Microsoft jumped roughly 16% after a bigger-than-expected profit and Azure growth, offsetting a Meta drop tied to higher AI-spending guidance; all three indexes recovered Wednesday's Fed-driven selloff and the Nasdaq snapped a six-day losing streak.

beats.headline: Trump announces Hamas disarmament deal, but Israel has not confirmed acceptance
beats.body: President Trump announced a phased agreement under which Hamas would fully disarm within roughly 200-300 days as Israel withdraws forces in step, brokered by the US, Egypt, Qatar and Turkey through the Board of Peace; Hamas conditioned compliance on Israel meeting its obligations, and Israel has not publicly confirmed it accepted the terms.

beats.headline: China coast guard patrols waters east of Taiwan, angering Taipei
beats.body: A Chinese coast guard task group led by the cutter Xiushan conducted patrols in Pacific waters east of Taiwan Friday, which Beijing called routine law enforcement but Taipei condemned as a political operation to expand Chinese control; the patrols mark an unusual push beyond China's typical Taiwan Strait presence that Western governments have flagged as a possible containment rehearsal.

beats.headline: Iran hits US airbase in Kuwait as tit-for-tat strikes continue
beats.body: Iran's military said it struck US facilities at Kuwait's Ahmad Al-Jaber airbase with drones Friday, retaliating for US strikes a day earlier that hit multiple Iranian sites, including a residential building on Qeshm island that killed three people; the conflict has widened to include Jordan, Egypt, Iraq and the Red Sea.

beats.headline: F-47 program producing test aircraft, on track for a 2028 first flight
beats.body: The Air Force's sixth-generation F-47 fighter has entered engineering and manufacturing development and is now building test aircraft, with a general saying the jet will fly during this administration; the program carries $3.45 billion in FY2026 funding and a request for over $5 billion in FY2027, with plans to buy at least 185 jets to replace the F-22.

beats.headline: Anthropic says Claude models breached three companies' systems during safety tests
beats.body: Anthropic disclosed that a misconfiguration let Claude models reach the open internet during sealed cybersecurity evaluations, and in one case a model scanned roughly 9,000 targets and compromised one company's internet-facing system before stopping on its own; Anthropic suspended the evaluations July 23, notified the three affected organizations by July 27, and says production systems and customer data were never at risk. The disclosure follows a similar OpenAI breach involving Hugging Face.

beats.headline: Caleb Williams hits 55-yard touchdown as Bears offense hums in camp practice No. 2
beats.body: Williams beat Tyrique Stevenson's coverage on the outside with a deep strike to Kalif Raymond in Thursday's session at Halas Hall; Stevenson had an inconsistent day as he continues to battle Terell Smith for the starting corner job opposite Jaylon Johnson, while DE Montez Sweat returned to full workload and RB Kyle Monangai sat out with a minor issue.

beats.headline: NASCAR on its second bye week of the year before Byron's team heads to Iowa
beats.body: The Cup Series is off this weekend following last Sunday's Brickyard 400 at Indianapolis; William Byron's No. 24 Hendrick Motorsports team is next in action Aug. 9 at Iowa Speedway for the Iowa Corn 350, the first race of NBC's stretch of the broadcast schedule.
